title.en: Yatto omae ga jigoku ni iku toko mireru ne ~ shōshaman ni enkyori furin sa rete ita watashi no 5-nenkan ~

altTitles.ja: やっとお前が地獄に行くとこ見れるね～商社マンに遠距離不倫されていた私の5年間～

altTitles.en: I finally get to see you go to hell ~My 5 years of being cheated on by a trading company employee~
It's time to watch you fall into hell

description.en:
Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture—
It was here that Chiaki met Keisuke, and here where they promised to marry.

After graduating from university, Keisuke joined one of Tokyo’s most prestigious trading companies.
Though their long-distance relationship wasn’t easy, Chiaki believed in the love they shared.

But… Keisuke changed in Tokyo.

Loud, cliché betrayals every weekend.
Endless lies to her face.
All it brought her was pain and humiliation.

Still, she swallowed it all in silence.
Yes, she knew… she knew everything.
And for five whole years, she let him live in his fantasy.

“Keisuke… the day is coming. I’m looking forward to it.”

Only three months remain until their wedding day.
